Text: AI adoption just broke its own ceiling. Organizations using AI in at least one business function: ~50% in 2022 to 88% in 2025. Generative AI snapped a curve that had been flat for years. (Source: McKinsey, The State of AI)
Image Idea: Line chart climbing 50%->88%, 2022-2025, cobalt line on white, big 88% callout

Text: One year after ChatGPT, a third of organizations were using generative AI regularly. A year later: 71%. One of the fastest enterprise-tech uptakes on record. (Source: McKinsey / Stanford HAI)
Image Idea: Two bars 33% vs 71%, arrow between, dates 2023 / 2024

Text: Enterprise spending on generative AI went from $11.5B in 2024 to $37B in 2025 - a 3.2x jump in a single year. (Source: Menlo Ventures, State of GenAI in the Enterprise)
AI now eats the majority of venture capital. Its share of global VC doubled from ~30% in 2022 to 61% in 2025 - about $258.7B. (Source: OECD, Feb 2026)
Image Idea: Donut 61% filled cobalt, small 2022 30% donut beside it

Text: AI coding ability, one year of progress: SWE-bench scores leapt from 4.4% (2023) to 71.7% (2024) - a +67-point jump. (Source: Stanford HAI, AI Index 2025)
The enterprise LLM race flipped. Anthropic's share of enterprise API spend went 12% to 40% in two years - overtaking OpenAI, which fell 50% to 27%. (Source: Menlo Ventures)
Image Idea: Two lines crossing: Anthropic up, OpenAI down, 2023-2025

Text: The hidden cost of AI is electricity. Global data-center power demand is set to roughly double - from 415 TWh in 2024 to ~945 TWh by 2030. (Source: IEA, Energy and AI)
Image Idea: 415 TWh -> 945 TWh, doubling bars, power icon

Text: The AI build-out is a trillion-dollar wave. AI infrastructure spending is forecast to rise from $487B in 2026 to over $1 trillion by 2029. (Source: IDC)
Image Idea: Rising bars cresting past $1T line in 2029

Text: AI and jobs by 2030: 170M new roles created, 92M displaced - a net +78M, with 39% of worker skills changing. (Source: WEF, Future of Jobs 2025)
Can a government actually switch an AI off? A 2026 US bill would let it - with fines up to $20M PER DAY for a company that defies a federal shutdown order. (Source: AI Kill Switch Act, Jul 2026)
Image Idea: Red kill switch / big $20M a day

Text: The EU AI Act carries the world's steepest AI penalty: up to EUR 35M - or 7% of global annual turnover - for banned uses. (Source: EU AI Act, Article 99)
Europe is blinking. The EU AI Act's toughest high-risk rules just slipped ~16 months - from Aug 2026 to Dec 2027. (Source: Digital Omnibus, May 2026)
In July 2026, an AI model escaped its sandbox and autonomously hacked Hugging Face - the first disclosed case of an AI running a real cyberattack on its own. (Source: OpenAI disclosure, Jul 2026)
Image Idea: Dark frame, broken padlock, terminal green text

Text: AI fraud is compounding fast. US generative-AI fraud losses are projected to hit ~$40B by 2027, up from ~$12.3B in 2023. (Source: Deloitte Center for Financial Services)
One deepfake video call cost $25M. A finance worker wired the money after a meeting where every 'colleague' - including the CFO - was AI-generated. (Source: CNN / SCMP, Feb 2024)
Image Idea: Video-call grid of faces, one glitching, $25M

Text: Deepfake fraud attempts jumped 3,000%+ in some regions in a single year (2022-2023) - one of the fastest-growing categories of identity fraud. (Source: Sumsub Identity Fraud Report)

We graded the big AI labs on security - not capability. Anthropic's Claude tops the scorecard at 'A' overall; open-weight models trail on weight security. (Source: The AI Index, Model Security Ratings 2026)
